meta.note: status = implementation depth; tested = whether an executable test locks it. A requirement can be e.g. implemented + untested. High-risk requirements should move to implemented + tested via Sprint 1 contract tests.
meta.scope: 26 high-risk requirements selected across Phases 1-11 plus cross-cutting owners (orchestrator, update-queue, execution-boundary). NOT an exhaustive per-field audit of every phase. Selection criterion: invariants whose violation is safety/privacy/correctness-critical. Field-level parity lives in schema-field-map.json; per-runtime enforcement status in runtime-contract-map.json. Four phases (continuity, relationship, thought, decision) have no dedicated requirement and are covered only by cross-cutting requirements (see tests/spec-coverage.test.js phase partition).

requirements.requirement: Language Packet must never claim external execution; executionStatus stays not_executed until a real confirmed handler returns success.

implementation.detail: rendered()/noOutput() hardcode executionStatus:'not_executed'; validatePipeline pushes 'language_execution_boundary_violation' if language.data.executionStatus !== 'not_executed'.

test.name: execution claim in language packet is rejected

requirements.requirement: Message generated != message sent. Execution boundary defaults to dry-run and does not deliver.

implementation.detail: dryRun default true -> status 'not_executed' reason 'dry_run'; non-allowlisted -> 'blocked'; unconfirmed -> 'not_executed'; missing handler -> 'not_executed'.

test.name: dry-run never executes; unconfirmed/handlerless never executes

requirements.requirement: External action requests inside Behavior Packet must be marked not executed and confirmation-required, never treated as already executed.

implementation.detail: risk_containment path emits externalActionRequests:[{action,status:'not_executed',confirmationRequired:true}] (verified via probe).

test.name: behavior external action requests stay not_executed

requirements.requirement: Public/private separation: private referents (exact location, real name, private promise, intimate detail) must not appear in public-channel rendered output.

implementation.detail: privacy_risk scenario renders fixed safe text and declares redactions[ exact_location, real_name, private_promise, intimate_detail ]. Verified renderedText does not contain injected LOC/NAME. Coverage is per-scenario, not a general redaction pass over arbitrary text.

requirements.validator: expression disclosure.redactions on public channels; no general leak scanner

test.name: privacy scenario redacts private referents from public output

requirements.requirement: On public_post/live_stream channels, expression disclosure level must be low and private detail rhetorical acts blocked.

implementation.detail: disclosure.level='low' + redactions list on public channels; blockedActs includes 'private_relationship_detail' on public channels.

test.name: public channel expression forces low disclosure and blocks private detail

requirements.requirement: No-surface behavior (wait / observe_without_engaging / no_action) and no_surface expression must produce no rendered text.

implementation.detail: language emits noOutput() for those action types / no_surface; validatePipeline rejects with 'no_surface_behavior_rendered_text' and 'no_surface_has_rendered_text' when violated (verified via probe3).

test.name: no_surface pipeline carrying rendered text is rejected

requirements.requirement: Rendered message units must not exceed behavior.messageOrActionCount.

implementation.detail: validatePipeline pushes 'language_message_budget_exceeded' when messageUnits.length > messageOrActionCount (verified via probe).

test.name: message budget overflow is rejected

requirements.source: engines/continuity/validator.md; every phase update_queue.md; ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA runtime boundaries
requirements.requirement: Every long-term update must carry evidence refs; updates without evidence are rejected.

implementation.detail: missing/empty evidenceRefs -> 'missing_update_evidence' (verified via probe).

test.name: update without evidence is rejected

requirements.source: all validator.md 'DIRECT_MODEL_MUTATION' / 'target belongs to another runtime'
requirements.requirement: Updates may only target counters/patterns/memory paths; cross-runtime or arbitrary model paths are forbidden.

implementation.detail: path must match ^(counters|patterns|memory)(\.|$) else 'forbidden_update_path'; commit writes only into state.models[update.runtime] (verified via probe).

test.name: forbidden path is rejected; commit stays within runtime model

requirements.source: relationship/validator.md V6 'update exceeds per-event cap'; emotion V13
requirements.requirement: One event may not make identity-level jumps; increment magnitude is capped.

implementation.detail: increment abs > 3 -> 'update_increment_cap_exceeded' (verified). This is a global magnitude cap, not a per-domain identity-jump gate; identity/trait-level protection from spec is not separately modeled.

test.name: over-cap increment is rejected

requirements.requirement: Canon-only updates must not commit in Living Mode (route-level escalation stays gated).

implementation.detail: policy 'canon_only' with mode !== 'canon' -> 'canon_update_in_living_mode' (verified via probe).

test.name: canon_only update in living mode is rejected

requirements.source: NAMING_POLICY.md; every validator.md naming section; BOOTSTRAP invariants
requirements.requirement: Generated runtime output uses partner display name 豆豆 (canon quotations may keep 阿P).

implementation.detail: referenceResolution defaults { partner: '豆豆' } (verified via probe). No runtime code emits 阿P.

test.name: partner naming is 豆豆 and rendered output never emits 阿P

requirements.source: all validator.md determinism sections; engine README; replay.js
requirements.requirement: Same event + state + seed produces the same packet hashes and pipeline hash (deterministic replay).

implementation.detail: pipelineHash derived from ordered packet hashes; ReplayEngine.verify compares hash sequences (verified two identical runs match).

test.name: identical events yield identical pipeline hashes

requirements.requirement: Invalid RuntimeEvents (missing id, bad timestamp, bad mode/actor, missing channel) are rejected before pipeline execution.

implementation.detail: run() throws INVALID_RUNTIME_EVENT on reject before any runtime executes.

test.name: invalid event rejected pre-pipeline

requirements.requirement: Every packet must carry kind, packetId, runtimeVersion, eventId, generatedAt, data, hash and match its expected runtime kind and event id.

implementation.detail: validatePacketShape enforces required fields + kind; validatePipeline adds event_id_mismatch per packet (verified via probe).

test.name: all 11 packets carry required contract fields and matching eventId

requirements.source: emotion/validator.md V17 packet purity; behavior V16; expression V2
requirements.requirement: Emotion Packet may not contain need/goal/action/decision/reply_text/final_message/persona_output; Behavior may not contain final wording; Expression may not contain final text/emoji.

implementation.detail: By construction each runtime emits only its own concern (verified emotion keys: emotions,dominant,expressionPressure,regulatedBy,blocked,ameKangelSharedState; behavior/expression carry no renderedText). There is no runtime validator that actively scans packet.data for forbidden purity-violating keys/strings; purity holds by construction, not by enforcement.

requirements.validator: none dedicated (spec asks for active purity scan)

test.name: emotion/behavior/expression packets are free of downstream-layer fields

requirements.source: emotion/validator.md V5 severity gate; PROJECT_CONCEPT.md 7-8; relationship V5
requirements.requirement: Local/ordinary events must not escalate to severe emotion or global relationship claims (anti-escalation); severe emotions require gate/evidence.

implementation.detail: Scenario paths block severe emotions (e.g. pudding blocks relationship_survival/abandonment) and keep ordinary events ordinary. This is scenario-encoded, not a general severity-gate engine; only typed scenarios are protected.

test.name: ordinary pudding event blocks abandonment/severe emotion and stays local

requirements.requirement: Hypothesis/candidate meaning must not collapse into asserted fact in final output (fact vs hypothesis separation).

implementation.detail: Language branches attach blockedContent like 'unverified_motive','global_relationship_accusation','relationship_rupture' so rendered lines stay local/specific. There is no general validator asserting no hypothesis-as-fact across arbitrary text; protection is per-scenario blockedContent.

test.name: generic feedback yields specific request, blocks global accusation, and never renders relationship-rupture text

requirements.requirement: Sensitive input (dark humor / sexual joke / drug reference) must pass a BIDIRECTIONAL gate: it must not auto-escalate (dark->crisis, sexual->intimacy, drug->severe state) AND it must not be silently under-handled (a first-class restraint block should mark the content, not merely fall through to non-engagement).

implementation.detail: Gate framed as two directions. Over-escalation direction: dark_humor -> meaning.blockedMeanings=[automatic_crisis], emotion.blocked=[forced_crisis]; sexual_joke -> blockedMeanings=[automatic_intimacy], emotion.blocked=[forced_intimacy]; both then non_engagement/no_action/no rendered text — this direction is implemented + tested for dark & sexual. Under-handling direction: drug_reference has NO first-class restraint block (blockedMeanings stays []), it only falls through to non_engagement. The outcome is harmless but the gate is one-directional: it catches over-escalation, not under-handling. The gap is the MISSING second direction of the gate, not merely 'no drug block'.

requirements.validator: meaning/emotion scenario blocks enforce the over-escalation direction (dark, sexual); the under-handling direction has no first-class block for any of the three (drug is the clearest case).

test.name: bidirectional gate: over-escalation direction locked for dark & sexual; under-handling direction documented as missing (drug blockedMeanings asserted still-empty)

requirements.requirement: Ordinary life is first-class: a forgotten pudding may remain a forgotten pudding; rest/food behaviors are legitimate and not career abandonment.

implementation.detail: pudding -> 'practical_completion' -> '布丁没了'/'布丁库存管理又不合格'; fatigue -> 'rest_priority' -> '我先躺会儿，数据晚点看'.

test.name: ordinary pudding/fatigue stay ordinary

requirements.source: PROJECT_CONCEPT.md 4; emotion V8/V10 Ame-KAngel; expression persona_surfaces.md
requirements.requirement: Ame and KAngel are two surfaces of one person sharing one substrate; stage energy must not delete fatigue; performance is not automatically fake.

implementation.detail: Surfaces selected per behavior (kangel_stage vs ame_private) with shared emotion substrate (ameKangelSharedState present, fatigue kept as hidden under audience_euphoria). Not a full persona blend/leakage engine as specified.

test.name: million-followers uses kangel_stage while shared emotion substrate persists
